abandon.en: The team decided to abandon the original plan after the first test failed.
abandon.zh: 第一次測試失敗後，團隊決定放棄原先的計畫。

absolute.en: There is no absolute rule that works perfectly in every situation.
absolute.zh: 沒有任何絕對規則能在每種情況下都完美適用。

abstract.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain an abstract scientific concept.
abstract.zh: 老師用圖表解釋一個抽象的科學概念。

access.en: Students can access the online library from home with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以用學校帳號在家存取線上圖書館。

accomplish.en: Careful planning helped the group accomplish its goal before the deadline.
accomplish.zh: 仔細規劃幫助小組在截止日前完成目標。

adaptation.en: The bird's thick feathers are an adaptation to the cold climate.
adaptation.zh: 這種鳥厚實的羽毛是適應寒冷氣候的特徵。

advocate.en: Many teachers advocate regular reading as a way to improve vocabulary.
advocate.zh: 許多老師提倡規律閱讀來提升字彙量。

aggregate.en: The report presents aggregate results from all participating schools.
aggregate.zh: 這份報告呈現所有參與學校的整體結果。

alter.en: A small change in temperature can alter the outcome of the experiment.
alter.zh: 溫度的小幅變化可能改變實驗結果。

anomaly.en: Researchers repeated the test to determine whether the result was an anomaly.
anomaly.zh: 研究人員重做測試，以確認這個結果是否為異常值。

applicable.en: The same rule is not applicable to every type of data.
applicable.zh: 同一項規則並不適用於每一種資料。

arbitrary.en: The cutoff point seemed arbitrary because no clear reason was given.
arbitrary.zh: 這個界線看起來很武斷，因為沒有提供明確理由。

attain.en: Regular practice can help students attain a higher level of fluency.
attain.zh: 規律練習能幫助學生達到更高的流利程度。

attribute.en: Scientists attribute the change to several environmental factors.
attribute.zh: 科學家將這項變化歸因於數個環境因素。

capable.en: This device is capable of measuring very small changes in pressure.
capable.zh: 這個裝置能夠測量非常微小的壓力變化。

coincide.en: The rise in sales happened to coincide with the start of the holiday season.
coincide.zh: 銷售上升剛好與假期開始的時間重合。

compatible.en: Make sure the software is compatible with your current operating system.
compatible.zh: 請確認這套軟體與你目前的作業系統相容。

complement.en: The chart can complement the written explanation in the report.
complement.zh: 圖表可以補充報告中的文字說明。

concurrent.en: The system can handle several concurrent requests without slowing down.
concurrent.zh: 這套系統可以同時處理多個請求而不會變慢。

confine.en: The experiment was designed to confine the heat within a small container.
confine.zh: 這項實驗設計用來把熱能限制在小容器內。

conform.en: All submitted reports must conform to the same formatting rules.
conform.zh: 所有繳交的報告都必須符合相同的格式規定。

contradict.en: The new evidence appears to contradict the earlier conclusion.
contradict.zh: 新的證據似乎與先前的結論相矛盾。

criteria.en: The judges used clear criteria to evaluate each presentation.
criteria.zh: 評審使用明確標準來評量每一場簡報。

deplete.en: Heavy use can quickly deplete the battery during a long trip.
deplete.zh: 長途旅行時，大量使用會很快耗盡電池。

detect.en: The sensor can detect small changes in light intensity.
detect.zh: 感測器可以偵測光線強度的微小變化。

discrete.en: The data were divided into several discrete categories for analysis.
discrete.zh: 資料被分成數個彼此獨立的類別進行分析。

displace.en: The new bridge may displace some traffic from the older road.
displace.zh: 新橋可能會把部分車流從舊道路分流出去。

elaborate.en: Please elaborate on your answer with one more supporting example.
elaborate.zh: 請再舉一個支持例子，進一步說明你的答案。

encounter.en: Students often encounter unfamiliar words when reading academic articles.
encounter.zh: 學生閱讀學術文章時常會遇到不熟悉的單字。

equilibrium.en: The system reached equilibrium after the temperature stopped changing.
equilibrium.zh: 溫度停止變化後，系統達到平衡狀態。

exceed.en: Do not exceed the maximum amount shown in the instructions.
exceed.zh: 不要超過說明中標示的最大數量。

exploit.en: The design tries to exploit natural light to reduce energy use.
exploit.zh: 這項設計試圖利用自然光來降低能源使用。

finite.en: The project had a finite amount of time and money available.
finite.zh: 這項專題可用的時間與資金都是有限的。

formulate.en: Students formulate a hypothesis before beginning the experiment.
formulate.zh: 學生在開始實驗前先提出假設。

hierarchy.en: The chart shows the hierarchy of roles within the organization.
hierarchy.zh: 這張圖顯示組織內各職位的階層關係。

inhibit.en: Lack of sleep can inhibit concentration during morning classes.
inhibit.zh: 睡眠不足可能會妨礙早上上課時的專注力。

inspect.en: Technicians inspect the equipment before students use it.
inspect.zh: 技術人員會在學生使用設備前先進行檢查。

intermediate.en: This course is designed for students at an intermediate level.
intermediate.zh: 這門課是為中等程度的學生設計的。

intrinsic.en: Curiosity can provide intrinsic motivation for learning difficult subjects.
intrinsic.zh: 好奇心可以成為學習困難科目的內在動機。

likewise.en: The first group improved after practice, and the second group did likewise.
likewise.zh: 第一組練習後進步了，第二組也同樣如此。

mature.en: A mature discussion considers evidence before reaching a conclusion.
mature.zh: 成熟的討論會先考量證據，再形成結論。

mediate.en: A teacher may mediate when group members cannot resolve a disagreement.
mediate.zh: 當小組成員無法解決分歧時，老師可以居中協調。

negligible.en: The difference between the two measurements was negligible.
negligible.zh: 兩次測量之間的差異小到可以忽略。

offset.en: Planting more trees may help offset some carbon emissions.
offset.zh: 種更多樹可能有助於抵銷部分碳排放。

paradigm.en: The discovery introduced a new paradigm for understanding the problem.
paradigm.zh: 這項發現帶來理解這個問題的新典範。

precede.en: A short introduction will precede the main presentation.
precede.zh: 正式簡報前會先有一段簡短介紹。

recur.en: The same problem may recur if the underlying cause is not fixed.
recur.zh: 如果根本原因沒有解決，同樣的問題可能再次發生。

relocate.en: The school plans to relocate the computer room next semester.
relocate.zh: 學校計畫下學期搬遷電腦教室。

simulate.en: The software can simulate how traffic changes during rush hour.
simulate.zh: 這套軟體可以模擬尖峰時段交通如何變化。

suppress.en: Closing unnecessary apps can suppress background activity on the device.
suppress.zh: 關閉不必要的應用程式可以抑制裝置的背景活動。
